statement: For every increasing real five-letter alphabet T=(t_0<t_1<t_2<t_3<t_4), if the rational span of its balanced mass-at-most-three zero profile has rank one and the primitive balanced generator has mass three, then M_3(T) is at most 33. Moreover, the maximum is exactly 33 and, modulo changing the generator's sign, the only relation directions with M_3=33 are (1,-3,0,0,2) and its reversal (2,0,0,-3,1).
contribution: A complete exact finite resolution of the frozen 36-to-33 gap: all 160 primitive mass-three directions modulo sign are enumerated, the exact tail-sum criterion leaves 65 order-feasible directions, and a complete census of all 40,920 translated increasing integer five-tuples of diameter at most 33 supplies and independently rechecks an exact-profile model for every feasible direction. The same census determines every profile minimum and the two extremal directions; a separate 165-core exact census proves the cluster lower bound. The literature search is bounded as documented and does not establish global priority.
